item.title: Self-Hosted PTP Servers: linuxptp vs chrony vs NTPsec for Sub-Microsecond Time Sync
item.description: Precision Time Protocol (PTP, IEEE 1588) delivers sub-microsecond clock synchronization across local networks — orders of magnitude more precise than NTP’s millisecond-level accuracy. For applications like financial trading, industrial automation, telecommunications, and distributed test systems, PTP is not optional; it’s a fundamental infrastructure requirement.
